name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 44 – Am 102
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 44c. Rejects the creation of “Europa Experience” centres, considering them an unacceptable waste of public funds to the detriment of the genuine priorities of European citizens; emphasises that maintaining high costs for these largely underutilised facilities constitutes inefficient and irresponsible management of budgetary resources; condemns the low level of interest in these centres, whose attendance remains marginal, and criticises their use as a propaganda tool aimed at promoting an ever-more-centralised Union at the expense of Member State sovereignty; rejects any attempt to expand this costly initiative; calls for a halt to any further investment in these spaces;
